maria: Trying to flip FP8 kernels on for H100/L40S for open-gpt-x bring-up; hitting intermittent NaNs in attention KV cache when seq > 1024. Anyone seen this before?
cheng: Is this the native FP8 runtime or AWQ/GPTQ path? Which kernel flags did you set?
maria: AWQ off, native fp8 kernels via env flags: REDWOOD_FP8_ENABLE=1, REDWOOD_FP8_MODE=auto. Repro: `python tests/infer_repro.py --model open-gpt-x --seq 2048 --batch 1`. Paste of the short log below.
```
[runtime] layer 24 attn_softmax: NaN detected in compute, tok=1453
[runtime] kv_cache_apply: overflow detected, resetting scale
[warn] fallback to fp16 for layer 24
```
kyle: Hmm looks like activation scaling mismatch. Did you use per-channel scale or per-tensor? AWQ/GPTQ use different scale conventions which can blow up in FP8 attention.
maria: We were using per-tensor (default). Forcing per-channel scale at model load removes the NaNs but the eval perplexity shifts +0.8% vs fp16 baseline.
lina: Try toggling REDWOOD_FP8_CAST_TO_FP16=1 or clamp window: REDWOOD_FP8_CLAMP=127. Also confirm driver/runtime; I saw different behavior between driver 525.x and 524.x on L40S.
cheng: Related note: there was an optimizer bug in the mixed-precision path that left residual scale state between forward passes when seq > 1024. Fixed in runtime v0.9.3-rc (PR #4321). Can you test against that build?
maria: Spinning up v0.9.3-rc on staging now. Our Dedicated fallback policy: route traffic to INT8 variant if we see NaNs or quality regression >0.5% for 30m.
sre-bot: deploy-bot: runtime rollout v0.9.3-rc to staging initiated by cheng :rocket: 
kyle: Add a smoke test: run 1k inferences across the eval prompt set, compute avg token-level cross-entropy delta vs float32 baseline. Block rollout if delta > 0.3% or any NaNs.
lina: Also include KV-cache persistence test: generate long context, then a short prompt; ensure no leftover scale state or cache corruption.
maria: Quick command I'm running locally: `export REDWOOD_FP8_ENABLE=1; export REDWOOD_FP8_SCALE_MODE=per_channel; python tests/run_fp8_smoke.py --model open-gpt-x --cuda_arch h100 --seq 2048`
cheng: If you hit NaNs collect these: `nvidia-smi dmon -s m -o TD &` and `tail -n 200 /var/log/redwood/runtime.log | grep -i fp8` — attach those logs to the issue.
kyle: FYI AWQ/GPTQ quantization recipes do bias/scale correction differently; when enabling FP8 kernels we observed 0.4–1.2% cross-entropy delta on some LLMs vs fp16 — expected in some families, so acceptance criteria need to account for model-specific baselines.
maria: OK rolling to staging now, will post the smoke results (loss deltas + NaN count) by EOD. Thanks all :thumbsup:
